checks: Date pricing is reachable from room types and rates
The following week can use a different nightly price
Pricing editor and scrollable calendar fit desktop and mobile
Booking UI displays all fourteen nightly amounts and saves the correct total
Clicking a calendar night opens a one-night edit
Restoring base prices changes new quotes and preserves booked nightly prices
scope: Local synthetic hotel only. No real guest messages, payments, or hotel price changes were made during QA.
concurrency_checks: 8 identical price saves create one audited change
8 conflicting calendar saves allow one winner and reject stale versions
Concurrent booking and price change preserve a consistent agreed snapshot or reject a stale quote
limitations: Prices are per room type and night; OTA outbound price synchronization is separate.
Existing bookings retain their agreed prices. Pre-feature stays retain legacy agreed-total distribution.
